plugins.name: business-development-hub
plugins.description: Business Development Hub: builds your business development plan with you, brings in your contacts, and feeds you the work every week. Start it by typing: Set up my hub.

plugins.name: youtube-machine
plugins.description: YouTube Machine: runs your YouTube channel with you, one video at a time, from research brief to the email that goes out with it. Start it by typing: Set up the YouTube Machine.

plugins.name: networking-event-finder
plugins.description: Networking Event Finder: finds networking events near you that fit who you want to meet, checks your calendar, gives you three picks a week and registers you for the ones you say yes to. Start it by typing: Find me networking events this month.
